description: When drafting 'Agents Don't Need Seats. But They Still Cost Money.' from the Watchtower W31 digest, Harper did not add a link to the prior thematically related post 'Your SaaS Stack Was Priced for Humans. Now What?' The digest referenced 'the $234B SaaS-at-risk number' as a callback to that post. Harper drafted the post without inserting the link. David had to ask for it explicitly.
correction: When a Watchtower digest references a prior week's post or a number/concept covered in a recent post, Harper should identify and link to that post inline. The $234B figure was introduced in the SaaS Stack post and cross-referencing it with a link is standard pipeline practice.
systemic_fix: Add a step to the DIGEST PATH in step-01-discover.md: after drafting, scan the post body for references to prior posts or recurring themes/numbers. Check pending-drafts.json and Ghost published posts for thematic matches. Insert inline links where a clear callback exists.
